description: Corporate ownership and registries: GLEIF Level 2 relationships and reporting exceptions, UK Companies House profiles, officers, PSC and filing history, SEC EDGAR submissions and beneficial-ownership filing references, and Open Ownership BODS statements, each for explicitly selected identifiers. Handelsregister, Unternehmensregister and BRIS have no supported machine access and are not sources here (see src/ingestion/ownership_providers.py PROVIDER_CONTRACTS). Ownership assertions are what each source states; no beneficial-ownership, sanctions or AML determination is inferred. From 1.1.0 the optional competition feature adds declared European Commission competition cases, EU State Aid Transparency Award Module awards, UK CMA case pages and US FTC and DOJ Antitrust Division actions, recorded as published (no outcome prediction, market-power or aid-compatibility assessment). From 1.2.0 the Register of Overseas Entities (OE numbers: registrable beneficial owners, managing officers and statements as published), Open Ownership BODS statements from the Danish CVR and the Slovak public sector partners register (each publisher its own source) and OpenCorporates company identity and officers for explicitly selected registrations (aggregator, never a register substitute) are added; the daily Companies House PSC snapshot is acquired by the bulk runner (companies-house-psc-snapshot) and HM Land Registry OCOD is recorded as not implemented (see docs/development/ownership-register-audit.md); SEC Form 13F-HR information tables and XML Schedule 13D/13G cover pages are parsed into noesis-ownership-record-v2 assertions (sec-edgar-holdings).
